import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊤ := rfl

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"

  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  | verum    => falsum

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

def complexity {n : ℕ} : Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
| ⊤        => 0
| ⊥        => 0
| rel _ _  => 0
| nrel _ _ => 0
| φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| ∀' φ     => φ.complexity + 1
| ∃' φ     => φ.complexity + 1

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n

  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"

  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where

# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n

  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊤ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_rel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(rel r v) = nrel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_nrel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(nrel r v) = rel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_all (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀' φ) = ∃' ∼φ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ex (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃' φ) = ∀' ∼φ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _

@[simp] lemma neg_univClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∀* φ) = ∃* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

@[simp] lemma neg_exClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∃* φ) = ∀* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

lemma neg_eq (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = neg φ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ➝ ψ = ∼φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ⭤ ψ = (∼φ ⋎ ψ) ⋏ (∼ψ ⋎ φ) := rfl

lemma ball_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : (∀[φ] ψ) = ∀' (φ ➝ ψ) := rfl

lemma bex_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : (∃[φ] ψ) = ∃' (φ ⋏ ψ) := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ball (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀[φ] ψ) = ∃[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma neg_bex (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃[φ] ψ) = ∀[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp [Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma all_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∀' φ = ∀' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[UnivQuantifier.univ]

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

@[simp] lemma univClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∀* φ = ∀* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, univClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma exClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∃* φ = ∃* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, exClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma univItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∀^[k] φ = ∀^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, univItr_succ]

@[simp] lemma exItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∃^[k] φ = ∃^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, exItr_succ]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj {φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n} :
    φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp [imp_eq]

abbrev rel! (L : Language) (k) (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) := rel r v

abbrev nrel! (L : Language) (k) (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) := nrel r v

def complexity {n : ℕ} : Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
| ⊤        => 0
| ⊥        => 0
| rel _ _  => 0
| nrel _ _ => 0
| φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| ∀' φ     => φ.complexity + 1
| ∃' φ     => φ.complexity + 1

  | verum    => falsum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊤ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _

@[simp] lemma neg_univClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∀* φ) = ∃* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

@[simp] lemma neg_exClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∃* φ) = ∀* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

lemma neg_eq (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = neg φ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ➝ ψ = ∼φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ⭤ ψ = (∼φ ⋎ ψ) ⋏ (∼ψ ⋎ φ) := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ball (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀[φ] ψ) = ∃[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma neg_bex (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃[φ] ψ) = ∀[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp [Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=

  by simp[UnivQuantifier.univ]

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

@[simp] lemma univClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∀* φ = ∀* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, univClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma exClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∃* φ = ∃* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, exClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma univItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∀^[k] φ = ∀^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, univItr_succ]

@[simp] lemma exItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∃^[k] φ = ∃^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, exItr_succ]

lemma bex_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : (∃[φ] ψ) = ∃' (φ ⋏ ψ) := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ball (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀[φ] ψ) = ∃[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma neg_bex (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃[φ] ψ) = ∀[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp [Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma all_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∀' φ = ∀' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[UnivQuantifier.univ]

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

@[simp] lemma univClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∀* φ = ∀* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, univClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma exClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∃* φ = ∃* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, exClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma univItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∀^[k] φ = ∀^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, univItr_succ]

@[simp] lemma exItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∃^[k] φ = ∃^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, exItr_succ]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj {φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n} :
    φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp [imp_eq]

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)
C0_dependencies.compilationAlias:

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

  induction n <;> simp [*, exClosure_succ]

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

/-!

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊥ := rfl

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊤ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_rel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(rel r v) = nrel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_nrel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(nrel r v) = rel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_all (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀' φ) = ∃' ∼φ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ex (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃' φ) = ∀' ∼φ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _

@[simp] lemma neg_univClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∀* φ) = ∃* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

@[simp] lemma neg_exClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∃* φ) = ∀* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

lemma neg_eq (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = neg φ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ➝ ψ = ∼φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ⭤ ψ = (∼φ ⋎ ψ) ⋏ (∼ψ ⋎ φ) := rfl

lemma ball_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : (∀[φ] ψ) = ∀' (φ ➝ ψ) := rfl

lemma bex_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : (∃[φ] ψ) = ∃' (φ ⋏ ψ) := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ball (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∀[φ] ψ) = ∃[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma neg_bex (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃[φ] ψ) = ∀[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp [Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma all_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∀' φ = ∀' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[UnivQuantifier.univ]

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

@[simp] lemma univClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∀* φ = ∀* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, univClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma exClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∃* φ = ∃* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, exClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma univItr_inj {k} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)) : ∀^[k] φ = ∀^[k] ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction k <;> simp [*, univItr_succ]
annotation:

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n) = ⊤ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_rel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(rel r v) = nrel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_nrel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(nrel r v) = rel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_exClosure (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(∃* φ) = ∀* ∼φ := by
  induction n <;> simp [univClosure, exClosure, *]

lemma neg_eq (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼φ = neg φ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ ➝ ψ = ∼φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma neg_bex (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃[φ] ψ) = ∀[φ] ∼ψ := by
  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp [Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ n) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ :=
by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma all_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∀' φ = ∀' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[UnivQuantifier.univ]

@[simp] lemma ex_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∃' φ = ∃' ψ ↔ φ = ψ :=
  by simp[ExQuantifier.ex]

@[simp] lemma univClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∀* φ = ∀* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  induction n <;> simp [*, univClosure_succ]

@[simp] lemma exClosure_inj (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∃* φ = ∃* ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

section ToString

variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)] [ToString ξ]

def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_nrel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) : ∼(nrel r v) = rel r v := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_ex (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) : ∼(∃' φ) = ∀' ∼φ := rfl

  simp [ball, bex, imp_eq]

import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Term
import Foundation.Logic.Predicate.Quantifier

/-!
# Formulas of first-order logic

This file defines the formulas of first-order logic.

`φ : Semiformula L ξ n` is a (semi-)formula of language `L` with bounded variables of `Fin n` and free variables of `ξ`.
The quantification is represented by de Bruijn index.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

inductive Semiformula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) : ℕ → Type _ where
  | verum  {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | falsum {n} : Semiformula L ξ n
  | rel    {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | nrel   {n} : {arity : ℕ} → L.Rel arity → (Fin arity → Semiterm L ξ n) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | and    {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | or     {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | all    {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n
  | ex     {n} : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1) → Semiformula L ξ n

abbrev Formula (L : Language) (ξ : Type*) := Semiformula L ξ 0

abbrev Sentence (L : Language) := Formula L Empty

abbrev Semisentence (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L Empty n

abbrev SyntacticSemiformula (L : Language) (n : ℕ) := Semiformula L ℕ n

abbrev SyntacticFormula (L : Language) := SyntacticSemiformula L 0

namespace Semiformula

variable
  {L : Language} {L₁ : Language} {L₂ : Language} {L₃ : Language}
  {ξ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Type*}
  {n n₁ n₂ n₂ m m₁ m₂ m₃ : ℕ}

def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

lemma neg_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : neg (neg φ) = φ :=
  by induction φ <;> simp[*, neg]

instance : LogicalConnective (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := fun φ ψ => or (neg φ) ψ
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

instance : DeMorgan (Semiformula L ξ n) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  imply := fun _ _ => rfl
  and := fun _ _ => rfl
  or := fun _ _ => rfl
  neg := neg_neg

instance : Quantifier (Semiformula L ξ) where
  univ := all
  ex := ex

  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

instance : Repr (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Semiformula L ξ n) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
